title: New Satellite Imagery Shows Destruction of US Military Quarters at Al-Salem Air Base
text:
New Satellite Imagery Shows Destruction of US Military Quarters at Al-Salem Air Base"

"Fresh satellite images, released by the "Sor Atlas" satellite imagery analysis center, show the destruction of two buildings used to house American military personnel at Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait."

"The Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran had previously announced that this base was targeted in response to the US war crime of attacking a wedding ceremony in Sirik.
